reasoning: This is a multi-component Kubernetes-native service platform for Models as a Service (MaaS) with real-time policy management. While it includes a Kubernetes controller (maas-controller using kubebuilder/controller-runtime with CRDs like Tenant, ExternalModel, MaaSAuthPolicy, MaaSSubscription, MaaSModelRef), the project is fundamentally a service platform rather than a standalone operator. It comprises three Go services — maas-controller (reconciles CRDs and manages model serving infrastructure), maas-api (HTTP API for keys, tokens, subscriptions with OpenAPI spec and PostgreSQL-backed storage), and maas-discovery (multi-tenant discovery service) — along with Kustomize deployment manifests and integration with external systems (KServe, Gateway API, Kuadrant/Authorino/Limitador). The controller deploys the API service automatically via its Tenant reconciler, making the controller one component of the broader service rather than the sole product.
